title: Standardize on "dissector data files" that contain no dissection
description:
There are several dissector data files that contain no dissection, just data structures (value_strings, etc).  Rename them with the prefix "data-" instead of "packet-" to make it clearer that they don't have any dissection functionality.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: This is at least a start.  I think a second MR may rename and move all of these python scripts to their own subfolder with a standard naming convention to make them easier to identify.

commits_data.title: Standardize on "dissector data files" that contain no dissection
commits_data.message:
Standardize on "dissector data files" that contain no dissection

There are several dissector data files that contain no dissection, just data structures (value_strings, etc).  Rename them with the prefix "data-" instead of "packet-" to make it clearer that they don't have any dissection functionality.
